goal.en: Read your own writing as a stranger would, and cut until only what you meant is left.
goal.ar: أن تقرأ كتابتك كما يقرأها غريب، وأن تحذف حتى لا يبقى إلا ما قصدته.

draft.title: A first draft
draft.text:
It is important to note that the process of onboarding new members of staff is something that has been identified as an area where there may be room for potential improvement. Feedback that was gathered from a number of recent joiners has indicated that there were some issues in relation to the provision of equipment, and it was also felt by some that the induction sessions could perhaps have been better structured than they were.

Going forward, it is our intention to undertake a review of the onboarding process with a view to implementing improvements in due course.

edited.title: The same paragraph, edited
edited.text:
Our onboarding needs work. Recent joiners told us that equipment arrived late and that the induction sessions were poorly structured.

We will review onboarding this quarter and report back in April.

head: Cut
Because
rows: It is important to note that
if it were not important you would not write it
is something that has been identified as
a verb is hiding in here
there may be room for potential improvement
vague time is worse than none
it was felt by some that
who felt it, and did they say so?

text.en: Cut anything that survives its own deletion. Read the sentence without the phrase: if nothing is lost, the phrase was never carrying anything.
text.ar: احذف كل ما يبقى المعنى بعد حذفه. اقرأ الجملة بدون العبارة، فإن لم يُفقد شيء فالعبارة لم تكن تحمل شيئاً.

text.en: Aim to cut a third of a first draft. Almost every first draft has that much in it, and the cut version says more, not less.
text.ar: استهدف حذف ثلث المسوّدة الأولى، فأغلبها يحتمل ذلك، والنسخة المحذوفة تقول أكثر لا أقل.

head: Vague
Precise
rows: some issues in relation to equipment
seven of the eleven who joined since March
it could have been better structured
three sessions covered the same material
I will report back on Friday

text.en: Every vague phrase is a decision the writer declined to make, handed to the reader. Precision is not a style; it is the work.
text.ar: كل عبارة غامضة قرارٌ امتنع الكاتب عن اتخاذه فأحاله إلى القارئ. والدقة ليست أسلوباً بل هي العمل نفسه.

text.en: Vagueness often survives editing because it feels safe. It is not safe: it guarantees that nobody can hold you to anything, including a promise you wanted credit for.
text.ar: يبقى الغموض بعد التحرير لأنه يبدو آمناً، وليس كذلك: فهو يضمن ألّا يُحاسبك أحد على شيء، بما في ذلك وعدٌ أردت أن يُحسب لك.

text.en: You cannot edit properly while you still remember what you meant. The techniques below all work by making the text unfamiliar again.
text.ar: لا يمكنك التحرير بحق وأنت لا تزال تذكر ما قصدت. والأساليب الآتية تعمل جميعها بجعل النص غريباً عليك من جديد.

head: Technique
What it catches
rows: ask what each paragraph is for

text.en: The final question is not “is this correct?” but “can this be misread, and would I mind?” At C2, that is the whole discipline.
text.ar: السؤال الأخير ليس «أهذا صحيح؟» بل «أيمكن أن يُساء فهمه، وهل يهمّني ذلك؟». وفي هذا المستوى، هذا هو الفنّ كله.

prompt.en: What does the first draft actually say?

options: Onboarding has problems with equipment and induction; a review is planned.
New staff have complained formally about the managers who recruited them.
The onboarding process was reviewed last year and found to be adequate.
Equipment has now been ordered for all new members of staff who asked.

explanation.en: Ninety words carry two facts and one intention. That gap is what editing closes.
explanation.ar: تسعون كلمة تحمل واقعتين ونيّة واحدة، وهذه الفجوة هي ما يسدّه التحرير.

prompt.en: Why cut “It is important to note that”?
prompt.ar: لماذا نحذف عبارة It is important to note that؟

options: Everything you choose to write is already claimed to be worth noting.
It is grammatically incorrect when placed at the start of a sentence.
It is far too informal for a professional document of this kind.
It should always be replaced by the phrase “It should be noted that”.

explanation.en: The phrase asserts importance instead of demonstrating it, and costs six words doing so.
explanation.ar: تدّعي العبارة الأهمية بدل أن تُظهرها، وتكلّف ست كلمات في سبيل ذلك.

prompt.en: Which sentence has nothing left to cut?
prompt.ar: أي جملة لم يبقَ فيها ما يُحذف؟

options: Recent joiners said their laptops arrived two weeks late.
It has been reported by recent joiners that there were delays.
Feedback indicates that some equipment issues may have occurred.
There appear to have been some delays in relation to equipment.

explanation.en: Subject, verb, fact. Every word in it would be missed if removed.
explanation.ar: فاعل وفعل وواقعة، وكل كلمة فيها يُفتقد معناها لو حُذفت.

prompt.en: Match the padded phrase with what it should become.
prompt.ar: صِل العبارة الحشوية بما ينبغي أن تصير إليه.

pairs: it is important to note that
it was felt by some that

explanation.en: Two of these are deletions and two are replacements with something checkable.
explanation.ar: اثنتان من هذه حذف، واثنتان استبدال بشيء قابل للتحقق.

prompt.en: What did the edit add that the draft lacked?
prompt.ar: ماذا أضاف التحرير ولم يكن في المسوّدة؟

options: A date, a named problem and a commitment.
A longer and more formal opening sentence.
An apology to the staff who complained.
The names of the joiners who gave feedback.

explanation.en: It is shorter and says more: equipment arrived late, sessions were poorly structured, report in April.
explanation.ar: أقصر وتقول أكثر: المعدات وصلت متأخرة، والجلسات سيّئة البناء، والتقرير في أبريل.

prompt.en: Which commitment can you be held to?

options: I will send the revised process by 18 April.
We will implement improvements in due course.
This will be looked at as a matter of priority.
We intend to address this going forward.

explanation.en: A person, an action and a date. The others are designed, consciously or not, to be unenforceable.
explanation.ar: شخص وفعل وتاريخ. أما البقية فمصوغة، بوعي أو بغيره، بحيث لا يمكن إلزام أحد بها.

prompt.en: Why is vagueness not actually safe?
prompt.ar: لماذا لا يكون الغموض آمناً في الحقيقة؟

options: It also prevents you claiming credit for what you did.
It always makes a document noticeably longer.
It is considered grammatically incorrect in reports.
It can only be used in informal writing.

explanation.en: A promise nobody can hold you to is also a promise nobody remembers you kept.
explanation.ar: الوعد الذي لا يُحاسَب عليه أحد هو وعد لا يذكر أحد أنك أوفيت به.

prompt.en: Make it checkable: “Some equipment issues were reported.” → “Laptops arrived ___ weeks late.” (write the sentence's missing word as a number word)
prompt.ar: اجعلها قابلة للتحقق: Laptops arrived ___ weeks late.

explanation.en: Any specific quantity beats “some issues”, because it can be confirmed or corrected.
explanation.ar: أي كمية محددة تتفوق على «بعض المشكلات»، لأنها تحتمل التأكيد أو التصحيح.

prompt.en: Why does reading aloud catch faults that reading silently misses?
prompt.ar: لماذا تكشف القراءة الجهرية عيوباً تفوتها القراءة الصامتة؟

options: A sentence you cannot say comfortably is badly built.
Reading aloud is slower and so more careful.
Speaking corrects spelling errors automatically.
The ear notices grammar the eye cannot see.

explanation.en: Breath is a structural test. If you run out of air, the sentence has too many clauses.
explanation.ar: النَّفَس اختبار بنيوي: فإذا انقطع فالجملة تحمل جملاً فرعية أكثر مما ينبغي.

prompt.en: Why leave a draft overnight before editing?
prompt.ar: لماذا نترك المسوّدة ليلةً قبل تحريرها؟

options: You stop remembering what you meant and start reading what you wrote.
New vocabulary tends to occur to you while you are asleep.
Editing is far more accurate in the morning than late at night.
It gives colleagues time to send their own comments on the draft.

explanation.en: Every editing technique is a way of buying back the ignorance your reader has.
explanation.ar: كل أسلوب في التحرير وسيلة لاستعادة الجهل الذي يملكه قارئك.

prompt.en: Match the technique with what it catches.

explanation.en: Each one attacks a different blind spot; none of them is optional on important writing.
explanation.ar: كل أسلوب يهاجم نقطة عمياء مختلفة، ولا يُستغنى عن أيها في كتابة مهمة.

prompt.en: What is the last question to ask before sending?
prompt.ar: ما آخر سؤال تسأله قبل الإرسال؟

options: Can any sentence here be read in a way I would not want?
Have I used enough formal vocabulary throughout?
Is every sentence grammatically correct in isolation?
Is the document long enough to look thorough?

explanation.en: Correctness is assumed at this level. What remains is what a stranger, or an opponent, could make of it.
explanation.ar: الصحة مفترضة في هذا المستوى، والباقي هو ما قد يصنعه بها غريب أو خصم.

prompt.en: Which opening sentence would survive a hard edit?
prompt.ar: أي جملة افتتاحية تنجو من تحرير صارم؟

options: Our onboarding needs work.
Onboarding may need some work.
Onboarding could be improved.
Onboarding is a concern area.

explanation.en: Four words, one claim, no hedge. It also commits the writer, which is why the others exist.
explanation.ar: أربع كلمات ودعوى واحدة بلا تحفّظ. وهي تُلزم الكاتب أيضاً، ولهذا وُجدت البدائل.

prompt.en: “It was also felt by some that…” What is this construction avoiding?

options: Saying who said it and how many of them there were.
Repeating a word that appeared earlier in the sentence.
Using a tense that would date the document.
Naming the department responsible for induction.

explanation.en: The passive plus “some” removes both the number and the people — and with them, the evidence.
explanation.ar: المبني للمجهول مع some يحذف العدد والأشخاص معاً، ومعهما يذهب الدليل.

prompt.en: What does a good editor do that a proofreader does not?
prompt.ar: ما الذي يفعله المحرّر الجيد ولا يفعله المدقق اللغوي؟

options: Ask whether each sentence earns its place at all.
Correct spelling, punctuation and agreement errors.
Check that the formatting is applied consistently.
Confirm that names and dates are spelled correctly.

explanation.en: Proofreading makes a sentence correct. Editing decides whether it should exist.
explanation.ar: التدقيق يجعل الجملة صحيحة، أما التحرير فيقرر ما إذا كانت تستحق الوجود.

prompt.en: Write a paragraph, then rewrite it thirty per cent shorter without losing anything.
prompt.ar: اكتب فقرة ثم أعد كتابتها أقصر بثلاثين بالمئة دون أن تفقد شيئاً.

context.en: Submit both versions. The second one is the exercise.
context.ar: قدّم النسختين، والنسخة الثانية هي التمرين.

checklist.en: The second version really is about a third shorter.
checklist.ar: النسخة الثانية أقصر فعلاً بنحو الثلث.

checklist.en: Nothing a reader needed has been lost.
I removed intensifiers that added nothing: very, really, quite.
checklist.ar: حذفت المؤكدات التي لا تضيف شيئاً مثل very وreally وquite.

checklist.en: I turned at least one noun phrase back into a verb.
checklist.ar: أعدت عبارة اسمية واحدة على الأقل إلى صيغة فعلية.

checklist.en: I cut every phrase that only announced what I was about to say.
checklist.ar: حذفت كل عبارة تُعلن ما سأقوله دون أن تقوله.

checklist.en: The shorter version reads better, not merely faster.
checklist.ar: النسخة الأقصر أفضل قراءةً لا أسرع فحسب.

model.en:
Before: It is important to note that there are a number of different factors which may potentially have an impact on the final outcome of the project, and it is therefore necessary for us to undertake a careful consideration of each of them in turn before any final decision is arrived at.

After: Several factors could change the outcome, so we should weigh each before deciding.

notes.en: Forty-nine words to twelve. Nothing was cut except announcements (“it is important to note”), hedges stacked on hedges (“may potentially”), and nouns that were verbs in hiding (“undertake a careful consideration” → “weigh”).
notes.ar: من تسع وأربعين كلمة إلى اثنتي عشرة. لم يُحذف سوى الإعلانات والتحفظات المتراكمة والأسماء التي كانت أفعالاً متخفية.

prompt.en: Write the same message twice: once to a close colleague, once to a regulator.
prompt.ar: اكتب الرسالة نفسها مرتين: لزميل مقرّب، ثم لجهة رقابية.

context.en: Same facts, same decisions, two registers. The content must not change.
context.ar: الوقائع نفسها والقرارات نفسها، بمستويين أسلوبيين مختلفين، دون تغيير المضمون.

checklist.en: Both versions state the same facts — I did not soften one of them.
checklist.ar: النسختان تذكران الوقائع نفسها ولم ألطّف إحداهما.

checklist.en: The formal version has no contractions and no idioms.
checklist.ar: النسخة الرسمية بلا صيغ مختصرة ولا تعبيرات اصطلاحية.

checklist.en: The informal version is not merely the formal one with “hi” at the top.
checklist.ar: النسخة غير الرسمية ليست الرسمية نفسها مع hi في أولها.

checklist.en: I chose Latinate words only where the situation actually calls for them.
checklist.ar: استخدمت الكلمات اللاتينية حيث يقتضيها المقام فعلاً.
لا تحتوي أي نسخة على كليشيه.

checklist.en: If both landed in the wrong inbox, only the tone would be wrong — never the facts.
checklist.ar: لو وصلت كل نسخة إلى الصندوق الخطأ لكان الخلل في النبرة فقط لا في الوقائع.

model.en:
To a colleague: Quick heads-up — we found the logging gap on Tuesday. It goes back about six weeks, so roughly 4,000 events were never written. Nothing was lost from the main store, but the audit trail has a hole in it. I have turned on the backup logger and Rania is writing the incident note today. We will have to declare it. Shout if you think I have the dates wrong.

To a regulator: We identified a logging failure on 4 March affecting approximately 4,000 events over a six-week period. No primary records were lost; the gap affects the audit trail only. A secondary logger was enabled on the day of discovery, and a full incident report will be submitted within five working days. We are treating this as a reportable event and will provide the affected date range on request.

notes.en: The facts are identical down to the number. What changes is who is assumed to be reading: the colleague gets a request to check the dates, the regulator gets the dates. Register is about the relationship, never about hiding anything.
notes.ar: الوقائع متطابقة حتى في الأرقام. ما يتغير هو افتراض من يقرأ: الزميل يُطلب منه التحقق من التواريخ، والجهة الرقابية تُعطى التواريخ. فالمستوى الأسلوبي شأن علاقة لا وسيلة إخفاء.
